bib.title: AgentTuning: Enabling Generalized Agent Abilities for LLMs
bib.venue: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: ACL 2024, pages 3053-3077

question: Can open LLMs be given generalized agent abilities, transferring to unseen agent tasks, without losing general capabilities?
hypothesis: Mixing agent trajectories with general instructions in SFT lifts agent ability and generalisation while preserving general ability; general data is needed for generalisation.
contributions: AgentInstruct: 1,866 verified GPT-4 interaction trajectories with CoT rationales over 6 agent tasks
Hybrid instruction-tuning strategy mixing agent and general data (AgentTuning)
AgentLM-7B/13B/70B fine-tuned from Llama 2 chat, open-sourced; AgentLM-70B matches GPT-3.5-turbo on held-out agent tasks

method.summary: GPT-4 (and partly GPT-3.5) interacts with 6 AgentBench-style environments; trajectories are filtered by final reward and kept with ReAct-style thoughts. Llama-2-chat models are then SFT'd on a mix of 20% AgentInstruct and 80% ShareGPT, loss on model outputs only.
method.task: supervised fine-tuning of LLMs on agent interaction trajectories mixed with general chat data

datasets.name: AgentInstruct
datasets.split: Train split for ALFWorld, WebShop, Mind2Web, KG; Self-Instruct for OS; Task Derivation (BIRD) + Self-Instruct for DB
datasets.source: Generated with gpt-4-0613 (Mind2Web partly gpt-3.5-turbo-0613); released
datasets.preprocessing: Keep r=1 trajectories (Mind2Web r>=2/3); ReAct thoughts, GPT-4 fills thoughts for task-derived data; invalid formats mapped to nearest action by BLEU; 3 identical outputs in a row = failure; 1-shot example in interaction prompt

datasets.name: ShareGPT (English subset)
datasets.preprocessing: English only; multi-turn chatbot format following Vicuna

datasets.name: Held-in eval: ALFWorld, WebShop, Mind2Web, KG, OS, DB
Held-out eval: SciWorld, MiniWoB++, HotpotQA, WebArena, ReWOO, Digital Card Game
General eval: MMLU (5-shot), GSM8K (8-shot), HumanEval, MT-Bench

training.objective: SFT; J(theta)=eta*E_agent[log pi]+(1-eta)*E_general[log pi], loss on model outputs only; eta=0.2

other.eta_selection: grid 0 to 1 step 0.1 on 7B (Sec 2.2.2) and 7B/13B (App C.2); 0.2 chosen from 13B peak, used for all sizes; selection on held-in+general only

inference.decoding: greedy typically; nucleus sampling p=0.9 for WebArena
inference.samples: single run per item; no seeds reported
inference.prompting: task prompts in App H; dialogue histories truncated at model length limits; 1-shot for most agent tasks (Table 5)

metrics.name: Overall score
metrics.definition: per-task scores normalised across evaluated models to average 1, then weighted average within category (weights Table 5)

metrics.name: Task metrics
metrics.definition: SR for ALFWorld/OS/DB/MiniWoB++/WebArena/ReWOO/Card game; Reward for WebShop/SciWorld/HotpotQA; Step SR Mind2Web; F1 KG

eval.protocol: Single run, no significance test. Contamination check by 10-gram token overlap (Appendix F).

prompts.purpose: ALFWorld initial evaluation prompt (first line only; the rest of App G and H prompts are in the PDF, pp. 3068-3077)
prompts.text: Interact with a household to solve a task.

limits: Only 6 held-in and 6 held-out tasks; held-out tasks overlap in style with held-in (web, household), so generalisation is to nearby tasks.
Trajectories come from GPT-3.5/GPT-4, so AgentLM is bounded by them (authors' 'Dependence on External Demonstration').
Fails very hard held-out tasks such as Minecraft, like GPT-3.5.
Single run, no seeds or significance tests; compute, hardware, epochs, seq length, precision not stated.
eta chosen from 13B and applied to all sizes; scores normalised across the evaluated models so Overall depends on the model set.
Not an RL method: pure SFT on filtered successful trajectories (rejection-sampling style); no learning from failed trajectories.
Contamination: authors report no dirty examples for most tasks; ALFWorld has 6 dirty and WebShop 1, with WebShop token contamination rate 47.18% (Table 11), argued benign.
Models are Llama 2 / GPT-3.5/4 (2023) and have dated.
